resolution.note: After the push ship retries every gh failure without an HTTP status or GraphQL answer with capped backoff for 5 minutes (3 tries before the push); a pr create whose reply was lost adopts the PR it created; a rerun with an empty diff on a branch whose PR merged prints verdict: merged and exits 0; an open PR is adopted and merged explicitly (ship merges with --match-head-commit, it does not enable auto-merge).

title: ship never gives up on a transient gh failure after push and resumes an existing PR
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: ship exited 70 on three different transient gh failures (TLS timeout, null statusCheckRollup, "error connecting to api.github.com"), each fixed one string at a time (#1182, #1188, #1189); one PR merged unattended after ship gave up, and rerunning ship then refused with 66 (empty diff) instead of reporting the merge.
Outcome: once ship has pushed, its watch and merge phases retry every gh failure that carries no HTTP status (any stderr without an HTTP 4xx/5xx answer) with backoff for up to 5 minutes instead of an allowlist of strings; a rerun on a branch whose PR is open adopts it (enables auto-merge, waits), and on a branch whose PR already merged prints `verdict: merged <sha>` and exits 0.
Why: every transient blip became a manual re-ship and a false failure.
Proof: ship tests with a fake gh that fails pr view with an unseen network message four times then answers -> merged; that answers HTTP 404 -> fails at once; a rerun against an already merged PR of the branch -> `verdict: merged` exit 0; against an open PR without auto-merge -> auto-merge enabled and merged.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts
